notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. DIT symbol sheet (Symbol Series: a sign component published as its own drawing; used on service, tourist and warning signs at the percentage each sign sheet states). Sheet WS141 (warning-series symbol): yellow plate, black pictogram. Layout: 1050 x 350, yellow, R0, no border. The board is located by its drawn outline; its artwork (semi-trailer truck, side view) is taken from the sheet's own filled shapes (PDF fills rendered at 1000 dpi without the dimension lines, traced), ink box x 30-1022, y 44-310.
